name: voiceover-cli
description: Record demo voiceovers line by line, with lines sent from your AI coding session over MCP

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/voiceover.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
